TV has been getting more and more cyberpunk lately. Everything seems more dystopian and futuristic, from the obvious Minority Report and Limitless shows to the more subtle, yet still noir dystopia of Jessica Jones and Gotham.

I think Mr Robot was the best cyberpunk TV of 2015. Aside from the great acting and writing, I don't think I've seen a film or show that captured the techno-noir atmosphere as well as Mr Robot. IMHO, Blade Runner almost captured it perfectly, but Blade Runner didn't quite hit that pure, hard boiled, noir chord, the way Mr Robot did. It's also technically accurate, so they don't pull you out of the story by montage hacking the NSA in 15 seconds.

What do you think?
